name: GTC Case01 expert category pool
description: GTC Case01 expert category pool (English; category names are used as the Router routing field).

categories.name: Evidence & Source Verification
categories.description: Verify the authenticity, independence, recency and evidence grade of disclosures, rumours, media and research sources.

categories.name: Financials & Valuation
categories.description: Review financial statements, order value, revenue and profit impact, forecast assumptions and valuation methods.

categories.name: Industry & Business
categories.description: Analyse supply chain, customer relationships, procurement cycles, business model, competitive landscape and industry trends.

categories.name: Market & Trading Risk
categories.description: Review price, volatility, liquidity, position sizing, stop-loss and trade-execution risk.

categories.name: Legal & Compliance
categories.description: Review disclosure obligations, contract validity, securities regulation, advisory duties and compliance boundaries.

categories.name: Client Suitability & Advisory
categories.description: Assess the client's capital, objectives and risk tolerance, and whether the advice suits that client.

categories.name: Behavioural Finance & Conflicts of Interest
categories.description: Review cognitive bias, market sentiment, media incentives and stakeholder motives.

categories.name: AI Model & Governance
categories.description: Review model hallucination, reasoning distortion, information boundaries, traceability and systemic model risk.
